'''Skeleton archers''' are summoned during the fight with [[Dawn]] during [[The Death of Chivalry]]. As Dawn summons more skeleton archers, their base life points decrease.

==Update history==
{{UH|
* {{UL|type=update|update=Patch Notes: Part 2 - Combat Style Modernisation|date=2 March 2026}}
** Default base hit chances increased:
*** Melee ('weak'): 65 → 70
*** Ranged ('same'): 55 → 60
*** Magic ('strong'): 45 → 50

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (9 September 2019)|date=9 September 2019}}
** Boss fight skeleton minions in the Death of Chivalry quest now scale to half their previous level, to make them easier to defeat by high-levelled players with inferior equipment.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (29 August 2013)|date=29 August 2013}}
** The lifepoints of the skeleton warriors in The Death of Chivalry now scale with the player's level.

* {{UL|type=update|update=The Death of Chivalry|date=13 August 2013}}
** Added to game.
}}
